For rho=-t, dividing by rho^2 gives 1296q(t), q=284t^6-512t^5+440t^4-224t^3+85t^2-16t+3. Exact degree-4 Bernstein coefficients of q''(u/3) are (170,58,394/9,878/27,934/27), all positive, and q'(0)=-16<0<178/27=q'(1/3); hence unique interior minimizer tau approximately 0.1655387555 with coefficient C*=2510.5126513. For positive rho the ratio >=3888, so the negative minimizer is globally sharp. At rho=0 equality is trivial; singular endpoints follow by polynomial continuity. These are symbolic identities and a convexity argument, not a finite-grid extrapolation.
